fichas.title: Dimensions for Wheelchair Users
fichas.summary: Design guidance and illustrated dimensions for wheelchair users, including wheelchair size, movement and turning areas, parking, slopes, stairs, workstations, windows, and passage through doors. Movement areas may overlap except in front of lift doors. The text calls for users to be able to function almost completely independently of outside help.
uses: Provide accessible spaces and circulation for wheelchair users
Support access to workstations, windows, stairs, and doorways
